role: AI Systems Software Engineering Intern – Summer 2027
jd:
NVIDIA is looking for an AI Systems Software Engineering Intern to apply AI agents, machine learning, and performance engineering to compilers and developer tools. You will work with compiler and AI engineers on a scoped project involving code, compiler and performance feedback, experiments, and optimization. Depending on your background and interests, the work may focus on agentic workflows, learned models, performance analysis, or AI-enabled developer tools. Experience in every area is not expected.

 What you’ll be doing: 
 
• Build AI-agent workflows that interact with code, compilers, benchmarks, performance tools, and engineering systems. 
• Develop tools that help agents collect data, run experiments, analyze compiler and performance feedback, identify optimization opportunities, and recommend next steps. 
• Explore data-driven approaches for compiler optimization, performance prediction, decision support, and workflow automation. 
• Build reliable interfaces between AI agents and compiler or developer-tool infrastructure. 
• Prototype improvements to compiler flows, optimization tools, experimentation systems, or developer workflows. 
• Work with compiler, architecture, AI, and performance engineers to evaluate ideas on representative workloads. 
• Measure correctness, runtime performance, compile time, reliability, and other relevant outcomes. 
• Document the design, experiments, results, limitations, and next steps. 
 What we need to see: 
 
• Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
• Strong programming skills in Python, C, C++, or a similar language. 
• Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, software engineering, and quantitative problem solving. 
• Coursework, research, or project experience in one or more of these areas: AI, machine learning, AI agents, compilers, programming languages, systems, performance engineering, optimization, or developer tools. 
• Ability to design experiments, analyze results, investigate technical problems, and communicate findings clearly. 
• Interest in learning across AI, compiler, performance, and systems boundaries. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 
• Experience building AI agents, LLM applications, evaluation systems, coding workflows, or developer tools. 
• Experience with LLVM, MLIR, compiler optimization passes, code generation, domain-specific languages, or compiler infrastructure. 
• Familiarity with GPU architecture, CUDA, GPU programming, or performance optimization. 
• Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, evolutionary algorithms, predictive modeling, ranking, search, or high-dimensional data analysis. 
• Research, internships, open-source contributions, or personal projects that measure runtime, compile time, resource use, code quality, or developer productivity. 
 
Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 20 USD - 71 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for Intern   benefits . ​

NVIDIA's invention of the GPU 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”.

 We are looking to grow our company, and grow our teams with the smartest people in the world. We are looking for you: a Computer Science or Computing Engineering grad student to support our NVIDIA Back-End Compiler Team for a 2021 internship! Our team is responsible for constructing and emitting the highest performance GPU machine instructions for Graphics (OpenGL, Vulkan, DX) and Compute (CUDA, PTX, OpenCL, Fortran, C++). This team is comprised of worldwide leading compiler engineering experts who provide cutting edge performance and capabilities for NVIDIA's current and future complex parallel SIMT architectures.

 What you’ll be doing: 
 
• You will be investigating and developing solutions to important and challenging problems within the NVIDIA Compiler Back End – consistent with your compiler experience and knowledge. 
• Work directly with a mentor and operate as part of the larger OCG team. 
• Work with global compiler, hardware and application teams to oversee improvements and problem resolutions 
• Be part of a team that is at the center of deep-learning compiler technology spanning architecture design and support through functional languages   
 What we need to see: 
 
• Currently pursuing a bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or similar field 
• Successful completion of an undergraduate Compiler Design class. 
• Strong writing and oral skills, as well as an ability to follow best practices for Software Engineering. 
• You possess strong coding skills with C++   
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 
• You have a graduate degree in a related field. 
• You wish to specialize in Compiler Design and Construction, and have pursued graduate coursework in these areas. 
• Hands-on experience with backend compiler design and code generation. 
• Experience with in any of the following areas is a plus: GPU and parallel architectures; CUDA and/or PTX; IR Compression. 
• Experience or strong interest register allocation or instruction scheduling. 
 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the brightest people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

jd:
About GlobalFoundries 
 GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com .

 Internship Program Overview:  
 Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives.

 Summary of Role: 
 You will be working as an intern on the AI Research team developing solutions that accelerate GlobalFoundries product development across design, PDK and specifications. You will collaborate with ecosystem startups, universities, internal AI researchers and semiconductor domain experts to evaluate and develop AI solutions, GPU acceleration capabilities, and agentic digital-backend flows for advanced 2D and 3D design.

 Essential Responsibilities include: 
 
• Create benchmarks for evaluating vendor, startup, AI, agentic-AI, and GPU-acceleration solutions. 
• Evaluate and create agentic AI digital-backend workflows that improve automation and productivity. 
• Support the establishment of engineering data environments and data warehouses that enable digital-backend agentic flows. 
• Develop monolithic 3D place-and-route flows, improve QoR, evaluate partitioning algorithms, and convert design-space exploration into agentic workflows. 
 Other Responsibilities: 
 
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 
 Required Qualifications: 
 
• Education – Actively pursuing a PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, VLSI Design, Computer Engineering or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship. 
• Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and be in good academic standing. 
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)  
• Must be willing to come on-site to the GlobalFoundries Santa Clara office. 
• Ability to work at least 10 hours per week during the internship.  
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 
• Prior related internship or co-op experience 
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. 
• Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making. 
• Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.  
• Strong written and verbal communication skills  
• Strong planning & organizational skills 
• Solved challenges on competitive platforms suchas Kaggle or equivalent AI/ML competitions; proficiency in Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, and graph-search techniques. 
• Experience with semiconductor design and automation; familiarity with Hugging Face, LangChain, Ollama, or related AI frameworks is a plus.

Please Note: 

 To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period. 

 Advancing the World’s Technology Together 

 Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future. 

 We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

 What You’ll Learn 

• Project Overview: Develop systems software for memory and storage pools that support reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models 

• Skills You’ll Learn: 

• Core Linux kernel memory management for virtual machines 

• How to modify the Linux kernel memory/storage management subsystem 

• Contributing to the largest open source project in the world 

• Understand how open-source SW impacts Samsung business 

• Collaborating across team, Samsung, and industry 

 What You’ll Do 

 The Samsung Global Ecosystem Team (GOST) is seeking an intern to develop systems software for memory and storage pools that support reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models. The work will examine how rollout generation, reward evaluation, policy updates, and checkpoint recovery use shared resources. You will build a focused prototype using fabric-attached memory and SSD pool, and measure its effect on training progress, memory pressure, and recovery time.

 GOST consists of a geographically distributed group of engineers making high impact contributions both in software and leadership to open ecosystems such as the Linux kernel and QEMU. This work supports Samsung’s latest storage and memory technologies.

 As an intern, you will contribute to the SW ecosystem R&D efforts targeting Samsung’s latest memory and storage technologies globally through distributed open-source projects. The goal of the internship is to deliver a working memory-to-storage data path, a live RL post-training demonstration, and a measured explanation of when pooling improves training efficiency or recoverability.

 Location: Daily onsite presence at our San Jose headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy 

 Reports to: Principal Engineer 

• 
 Responsibilities 

• Profile the RL post-training loop to identify memory-capacity limits, data-transfer overhead, storage stalls, and GPU idle time. 

• Develop one runtime feature that coordinates bounded memory staging, asynchronous storage writes, prefetching, or capacity allocation across workers. 

• Integrate the feature with an existing RL framework using its training and checkpoint interfaces. 

• Preserve snapshot consistency, policy-version provenance, buffer ownership, and durable checkpoint publication during asynchronous operations. 

• Compare memory-only, storage-only, and combined pool configurations using training throughput, GPU-hours, local-memory usage, and restart performance. 

• Deliver correctness tests, reproducible experiments, design documentation, and code suitable for review and potential open-source contribution. 

• Find the resource management issue on post-RL workload and resolve the issue in host OS. 

• Complete other responsibilities as assigned. 

• Complete other responsibilities as assigned. 

 What You Bring 

• Pursuing Masters, or PhD in Computer Science 

• Must have at least 1 academic quarter/semester remaining 

• Programming experience in C, C++, or Rust, with Python or shell scripting for experiments and automation. 

• Understanding of operating systems, memory management, concurrency, and computer architecture. 

• Experience developing and debugging on Linux, using Git, and communicating technical results—coursework and research projects count. 

• CXL, NUMA, Device-DAX, mmap, shared-memory programming, or memory allocators, preferred 

• GPU programming, CUDA, DMA, or profiling memory and data-transfer performance, preferred 

• Distributed systems, cache management, vllm, sglang, LLM inference, or open-source development, preferred 

• You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people. 

• An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding. 

• You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches. 

• Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change. 
 What We Offer
 The pay range below is for all roles at this level across all US locations and functions. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. 

 This is in addition to our diverse package of benefits centered around the wellbeing of our employees and their loved ones. In addition to the usual Medical/Dental/Vision, our inclusive rewards plan empowers our people to care for their whole selves. An investment in your future is an investment in ours. 

 Relocation Support Live 50+ miles away from your new office? No worries! We'll provide a stipend to help support your move. 
Housing Stipend Signing a lease on a new place for your summer internship? We'll help you pay your way with a monthly stipend. 
Give Back With a charitable giving match and frequent opportunities to get involved, we take an active role in supporting the community. 
Prioritize Emotional Wellness With on-demand apps and paid therapy sessions, you’ll have support no matter where you are. 
Stay Fit Eating well and being active are important parts of a healthy life. Our onsite Café and gym, plus virtual classes, make it easier. 
Embrace Flexibility Benefits are best when you have the space to use them. That’s why we facilitate a flexible environment so you can find the right balance for you. 

 Hourly Base Pay Rate
 $28 — $68 USD 

 Equal Opportunity Employment Policy  

 Samsung Semiconductor takes pride in being an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to excel, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status.

We extend comprehensive accommodations throughout our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, neurodivergent individuals, or those requiring pregnancy-related support. role: 2027 Summer Intern - AI/ML Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles

jd:
About Westmag

Westmag is the American manufacturer of drone motors and robot actuators, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, NFDG, Menlo Ventures, and other top investors. Westmag is committed to building and scaling in the U.S. to serve the global market. For more information, visit westmag.com http://westmag.com.

About the Internship & Co-op Program

Westmag offers exciting Internship and Co-op opportunities for students eager to gain hands-on experience in the fields of engineering, operations, product development and business functions. Interns and co-op students will work closely with full time engineers, contributing to impactful projects that support Westmag's mission to innovate in drone motor manufacturing.

Role Description

 - Work alongside the software team to build and maintain internal web applications and services that support Westmag’s engineering and manufacturing operations.

 - Develop full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js, backed by PostgreSQL databases.

 - Help containerize, deploy, and operate services on AWS, including improving CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.

 - Support integrations between factory equipment, test stations and software systems, including data collection and monitoring.

 - Write automated tests, contribute to code reviews and technical documentation, and take on research tasks as assigned.

 - Collaborate with engineering, operations and production teams to turn real factory needs into working software.

Eligibility & Qualifications

 - Currently enrolled in a Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related undergraduate or graduate program.

 - Strong interest in robotics, drone technology, manufacturing or technology startups.

 - Previous internship, personal projects or project-based student org experience (Formula SAE, Rocketry, Design Build Fly, hackathons, etc.).

 - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

 - Good communication skills and willingness to learn.

 - Authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the internship/co-op period.

Technical Skills

 - Strong TypeScript/JavaScript skills; comfortable with React and Node.js.

 - Experience with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).

 - Fluency with Git and the command line; Linux basics.

 - Familiarity with Docker and container-based deployment.

 - AWS fundamentals (ECS, RDS, IAM, CloudFront/ALB); Terraform a plus.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).

 - Networking basics: DNS, TLS/certificates, subnets, firewalls, and VPN.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with MQTT or other industrial/IoT protocols.

 - Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration, or end-to-end).



Westmag is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, or protected veteran status.
fit_why: TypeScript/React/Node/PostgreSQL full-stack match; some AWS and MQTT gaps

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. Role Overview

Qualcomm develops leading-edge ASIC and SoC solutions spanning compute, connectivity, and AI acceleration, including Snapdragon processors. Our team focuses on connectivity and data-center silicon, developing advanced ASIC/SoC solutions for high-bandwidth networking, infrastructure compute, and AI workloads. 
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineering & AI Co-op student to build full-stack applications, AI-powered tools, and automation for ASIC design flow. We’re looking for someone who has hands-on experience with Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, modern web technologies and project management, plus an interest in applying AI to real engineering problems.

Responsibilities may include:

 * Building responsive web applications using React

 * Developing backend services and APIs using Node.js

 * Designing and working with PostgreSQL databases

 * Building AI-powered tools and agentic workflows, including orchestrating AI agents and integrating LLMs with tools, APIs, and engineering systems

 * Exploring AI-assisted CAD/design and engineering automation

 * Improving developer tools, testing, automation, and engineering workflows

 * Collaborating across software, hardware, firmware, AI, and DevOps teams 

 * AI assisted project management, including tracking tasks and deliverables, coordinating across teams, following up on action items, and helping keep projects on track

Minimum Qualifications:

 * Pursuing Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related degree

 * Demonstrated experience building full-stack applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL

 * Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST API, Git, and Linux fundamentals

 * Understanding of LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, tool calling, and agent orchestration

 * Interest or experience in AI-assisted CAD/design or engineering workflows

 * Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn and build quickly

Preferred Qualifications:

 * Python and experience with LLM APIs, RAG, or agent frameworks

 * CAD/EDA, design automation, or hardware/software experience

 * C/C++, networking, Docker, CI/CD, or automated testing

 * Personal, academic, or internship projects demonstrating full-stack or AI development

Education Requirements:

 * In study towards a bachelor’s degree in one of the following: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Engineering Science, Computer Science, or related field
 * For 4-month internships: must be available May/June 2027 - August/September 2027
 * Expected graduation date of November 2027 or later.
 * 1+ years of academic experience with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, etc

Qualcomm’s Internship Program

Our interns join world-class teams to help define and build what is next for mobility and the world. You’ll be paired with a mentor with visibility to your project and team, receive support from your manager, and have access to the entire Qualcomm employee community to ensure your success. To round out your internship, we host professional development workshops, social events, cross-functional speaker sessions, and an executive speaker series. In addition to competitive hourly pay and accrued vacation time, you will receive housing stipend to accommodate for the duration of your internship. 

Application Process

We will review resumes on an ongoing basis, and a recruiter may reach out to you. Advancing candidates may be invited to complete a timed HackerRank challenge to evaluate their technical skill set. 

Export Control Notice

This role may require an export license for candidates with citizenship in certain countries (see current country list below – subject to change). Qualcomm, like other companies, is experiencing significant delays in the export license process. Please be advised that if an export license is required, you may not be able to start work with Qualcomm until the license is granted, which may impact your ability to participate in the internship.

Build the Path Forward 

 At Path Robotics, we’re attacking a trillion dollar opportunity — doing things that have never been done before to support an industry hurting from a lack of skilled labor. Big, hard problems are what Path tackles every day, and our people are our greatest asset to get that job done. Our intelligent, hardworking team does the impossible every single day, yet remains incredibly kind, humble, and always ready to support one another.

 We’re looking for a Machine Learning & Robotics Intern to spend 12 weeks next spring or summer building real software for robots that sense, plan, and act. Whether your background leans toward robotics (planning, control, kinematics) or machine learning (perception, reinforcement learning, deep learning), we’ll match you with a project that fits your strengths — and you’ll see your code run on live robotic cells doing real work. You’ll be paired with a mentor and work alongside our Robotics and Weld Intelligence teams from day one.

 What You’ll Do 

 Every intern owns a scoped, production-relevant project from design through testing on real hardware, then presents results to the team at the end of the summer. Depending on your interests, your project could include:

• Robotics: motion and trajectory planning, inverse kinematics and reachability, real-time control and feedback loops, visual servoing, or localization and navigation for mobile platforms. 

• Machine learning: vision-based perception, reinforcement learning or imitation learning for motion and control, learned planners, or sim-to-real training in tools like Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or Gazebo. 

• Robot learning: behavioral cloning, diffusion policies, or vision-language-action (VLA) models for manipulation, trained on multi-modal data such as images, force, and torque. 

• Where they meet: combining classical robotics with learning-based methods to make our robots faster, smarter, and more capable. 
 
 Who You Are 

 You don’t need to be an expert in both robotics and ML — depth in one and curiosity about the other is what we’re after.

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 

• Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python. 

• Coursework, research, or project experience in robotics (planning, controls, kinematics, dynamics) or machine learning (computer vision, deep learning, reinforcement learning). 

• For robot learning projects: coursework or research in imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or diffusion-based policies, ideally applied to robot manipulation. 

• Comfortable working on Linux and using Git. 

• You learn fast, enjoy debugging hard problems, and can explain your work clearly to people outside your specialty. 
 
 Why You’ll Love It Here 

• Real ownership: your project ships to robots doing real production work, not a sandbox. 

• A dedicated mentor plus regular time with engineers across robotics, ML, and hardware. 

• Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team. 

• Competitive hourly pay.  
 
 Who We Are 

 At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.
 
Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.


We're currently filling spots for our 2027 full-time AI Engineer summer internships at our headquarters in Lehi, Utah. In this internship you will dive into some of the toughest problems for our users and across the international e-commerce space with a goal of figuring out how to solve those problems with technology. We are accepting applications for undergraduate and graduate students.
This is a full-time Summer 2027 internship that will last roughly 12 weeks and work a hybrid schedule from our office in Lehi, Utah.




What is a day in the life of an AI Engineer Intern?:
• 
 Assist with data preprocessing, cleaning, and analysis to prepare high-quality datasets for model training. 

• 
 Support the development and optimization of machine learning models, including tasks like fine-tuning hyperparameters and evaluating performance. 

• 
 Participate in the deployment of AI solutions, collaborating with senior engineers to integrate models into production systems. 

• Document AI experiments, code, and project workflows to ensure clear and reproducible processes. 

• 
 Research cutting-edge AI technologies and methodologies to contribute to the team's ongoing innovation efforts.

What will I need to thrive in this role?:
• 
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. 

• 
 Foundational knowledge of machine learning concepts and algorithms. 

• 
 Proficiency in a programming language commonly used in AI, such as Python or Java. 

• Familiarity with at least one machine learning framework (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is preferred. 

• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with an eagerness to learn and contribute in a collaborative environment.

What does high performance look like?:
• 
 You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given 

• 
 You actively comment and participate in group collaborations 

• You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion 

• You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

What is my potential for career growth?:
You will work extensively with members of the AI team at Pattern. You will have the chance to learn and grow under their mentorship. The right candidate, executing at a high level, may be considered for a full-time role post internship, or an extension to continue working with the team part-time after returning to school.

What is the team like?:
Pattern’s AI team brings experience from the world’s top tech and ecommerce companies. The team is composed of a Director of Product - AI Research & Development, Senior AI Product Managers, and AI Engineers. You will work directly and cross functionally with these team members, as well as other members of the tech teams at Pattern.

What is the hiring process?:
• 
 Onsite technical assessment 

• 
 Additional interviews as needed 

• 
 Executive Review 

• 
 Offer

Sounds great! What's the company culture?
 
- Game Changers: A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes. 
- Data Fanatics: A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. 
- Partner Obsessed: An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. 
- Team of Doers: Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. 
 
How can I stand out as an applicant?
 
- Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples 
- Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team 
- Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed at Pattern 
- Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics 
 
Why should I work at Pattern?
 
Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives.
